answer: Tapered-refund entry deposit: every new wallet locks 9 POA, and only 1 POA returns per epoch over 9 epochs. An honest user ties up 9 POA, while 1,000 fake wallets need 9,000 POA parked at once. Recycling early refunds into new fakes fails, because each epoch 4% of wallets get a mirror audit that traces the deposit's funding source, and a fable of independent users falls apart when one funder shows up behind a quartz-sized cluster. A failed audit forfeits the unreturned 60% of that deposit. Patient attackers with real capital can still pay.
